title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_missing_company_uuid
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; caller is an assigned evaluator.
steps: 2. POST /evaluations with the journey body minus company_uuid.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, error.code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — Evaluations::ValidateService#valid_params? requires @options[:company_id].present? (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:44). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: company_id is the first of the three ANDed conditions in valid_params?; without it the score has no vendor to attach to.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_missing_form
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with trade_request_uuid and company_uuid only.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — @options[:form].present? is false (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:45). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Second ANDed condition of valid_params?; the lock identifier also reads params.dig(:form, :id), so a missing form must not break the before_action either.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_form_without_uuid_or_id
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form {score: 3, remark} and no uuid/id.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — valid_form? needs form[:id].present? (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:61). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: The journey sends form.uuid, which ParamsAuth rewrites to form.id; a client that forgets it must get code 2, not a score on 'no form'.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_form_id_as_string
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form.id sent as the string "10" (no uuid).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — form[:id].instance_of?(Integer) is false for a string (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:62); ParamsAuth only decodes keys containing 'uuid', so 'id' is passed through untouched. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Only form.uuid is decoded to an Integer; a raw form.id must be a JSON integer. The Integer check is what stops '10abc'-style coercion matching an allowed id.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_form_not_assigned_to_caller_with_code_2
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; the caller evaluates a DIFFERENT line item's form; the body deliberately keeps the non-existent form Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== instead of {{evalFormUuid}}.
steps: 1. As evaluator A, POST /evaluations with the form uuid assigned to evaluator B (here the non-existent Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 'Insufficient parameters' (not 101) — form[:id].in?(get_allowed_forms_for_user(...).pluck(:id)) is part of valid_form? (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:63), which runs before validate_evaluator. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Scoring someone else's form surfaces as a PARAMS error, which is why the journey sees 'Insufficient parameters' when it picks the wrong form. A regression that moves the form check into validate_evaluator would change the code the UI keys on.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_missing_score
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form {uuid, remark} and no score.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — form[:score].present? is false (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:64). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: A missing score must not be stored as nil: nil scores drop out of QCS averages and silently raise a vendor's mean.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_score_as_numeric_string
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — form[:score].instance_of?(Integer) is required unless the event is vendor-onboarding v2 (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:65). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Form inputs are strings by default; a client that forgets to parseInt gets 'Insufficient parameters' with no hint the TYPE is the problem.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_decimal_score
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — 3.5 is a Float, not Integer (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:65), and not a label key (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:66). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Scores are discrete label keys; a half-score would not map to any label (TNA/T1/T2…) and would break display_value_for_evaluation_score.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_score_6_above_default_label_set
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; the RFP uses the default evaluation_score_label_mapping (scores 0-5); form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form.score = 6 (one above the highest default label).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — form[:score].in?(event_group.get_evaluation_score_vs_label.keys) is false; the default mapping has keys 0..5 (db/migrate/20250209130259_set_evaluation_score_label_mapping.rb, app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:66). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: ROOT CAUSE of the journey's intermittent 'Insufficient parameters': eventJourney.ts scores randInt(1,10), so every draw of 6-10 is refused. The score is NOT 'out of 10' — it is a label key.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_negative_score
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — -1 is not a label key (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:66). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: A negative score would pull a weighted QCS total below zero.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_zero_score_with_empty_remark
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; not vendor-onboarding v2; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — a zero score is only valid when form[:remark].present? (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:67-69); "" is not present. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Score 0 is TNA (technically not accepted) in the default mapping — the one score that disqualifies a vendor from awarding. An empty-string remark is the easy bypass of the mandatory justification.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_accepts_zero_score_with_remark_boundary
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator; 0 is a key of the event's evaluation_score_label_mapping (TNA in both defaults).
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form.score = 0 and a real remark.
expectedResult: 200 success:true — 0 is a label key and the remark is present, so valid_form? passes; a draft evaluation_score of 0 with a Remark row is written. (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:67-69, app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:1099)
rationale: Pairs with the two refusals above: the rule is 'zero needs a reason', not 'zero is forbidden'.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_accepts_highest_label_score_5
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; 5 is a key of the event's evaluation_score_label_mapping; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with form.score = 5 (highest default label key).
expectedResult: 200 success:true — 5 is a key of both default mappings (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:66). NOTE the per-RFP mapping from the 2025-02 migration makes 5 = 'Regret', which BLOCKS awarding when restrict_awarding_for_tna_vendors is on (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:1271-1280). If the event's mapping tops out below 5 this becomes code 2.
rationale: The top of the range is a boundary AND, depending on which mapping the RFP carries, a disqualification — the same number means T1 in the company default and Regret in the per-RFP default.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_every_score_when_rfp_has_no_label_mapping
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; the RFP's config has no evaluation_score_label_mapping key (EventGroup#evaluation_score_label_mapping uses the RFP's config whenever an RFP exists, and TradeRequest#evaluation_score_label_mapping returns [] when the key is absent); form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with a normally valid score 3.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 for EVERY score — get_evaluation_score_vs_label.keys is [] (app/models/event_group.rb:718-735, app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:912-914). The company-level MasterConfiguration default is never consulted once an RFP exists. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: CONFIG trap: no code path writes evaluation_score_label_mapping into a NEW RFP's config (only the 2025-02 backfill migration did). If new RFPs lack it, scoring is impossible and every attempt reads as 'Insufficient parameters'.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_remark_as_integer_must_not_500
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: Must be a 422, not a 500. Today valid_form? passes (remark is only checked for score 0) and find_or_create_remark calls message.html_safe on an Integer (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:1120), which raises NoMethodError → 500.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the remark is never type-checked; only strings have html_safe.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_score_breakdown_as_string_must_not_500
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: Must be a 422. build_updated_score_obj calls score_type_vs_key_attribute_vs_score&.to_unsafe_h (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:1108), which a String does not have → 500 today.
rationale: Optional nested hash never validated for type.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rescore_dropping_breakdown_must_not_500
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; the evaluator already saved a score WITH score_type_vs_key_attribute_vs_score; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 2. Re-score the same form without the breakdown key.
expectedResult: Must be 200 or 422. get_meta_data_for_evaluation_score iterates the OLD breakdown and indexes new_score_type_vs_key_attribute_vs_score[...] on nil (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:1161-1172) → NoMethodError → 500 today.
rationale: Re-scoring is routine; a partial payload on the second save is exactly what a UI that only sends changed fields does.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_before_bid_end_time
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; the RFP is still accepting responses (bid_end_time in the future).
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with a valid body while the RFP is live.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 'Order not active' — render_error_json(33) if trade_request.bid_end_time > Time.now (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:25). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Two-envelope confidentiality: scoring while vendors can still edit would let a score leak and responses change after it.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_commercial_stage_id
preconditions: {{tradeId}} is the PRICING (RFQ) stage of the sandbox event; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with trade_request_uuid = the RFQ stage ({{tradeId}}) instead of {{rfpTradeId}}.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 — the lookup is TradeRequest.active.rfi_or_rfp (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:14-16), so an RFQ/auction id finds nothing. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Commercial stages have no forms; the scope is the only thing stopping a score being filed against a price round.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_draft_rfp_stage
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is an RFP stage still in draft (event not activated).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 — TradeRequest.active excludes status draft (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:14). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Wrong order of actions: evaluating an event no vendor has seen.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_vendor_caller
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; caller is the VENDOR user.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 — the lookup is scoped to company_id: Current.workspace.id (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:14); the vendor's workspace owns no RFP. No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Self-scoring is the most direct fraud on a technical evaluation.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_vendor_without_active_response
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; {{vendorUuid}} was invited but never submitted a technical response (or it was deleted).
steps: 1. POST /evaluations for that vendor with the evaluator's assigned form.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — allowed_to_evaluate_participant? requires trade_request.template_responses.active.exists?(company_id:) (app/services/evaluations/validate_service.rb:79). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Scoring a non-respondent invents a qualification for a vendor who never qualified; code 101, not 2, is the tell that the params were fine.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_rejects_double_click_inside_lock
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time has passed; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. Fire two identical POST /evaluations within 3 seconds.
expectedResult: The second returns HTTP 422 code 516 'Transaction in Progress' — lock_evaluation_create keys on trade/company/form/user for 3s (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:126-132). Exactly one evaluation_score row.
rationale: Without the lock two draft Evaluation rows are created for the same vendor (the find-or-new at app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:25-36 is not atomic).

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_after_evaluation_window_is_not_time_guarded
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; now is AFTER extra_closing_time (the evaluation window has ended) but the stage is still status active.
expectedResult: Today the create action only checks the LOWER bound (bid_end_time > now → 33, app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:25); nothing refuses a score after extra_closing_time. Expected per product rules: refused. Must never 5xx.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: re-evaluation is explicitly limited to in_evaluation_time? (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1352) but first-time scoring is not, so a late score changes QCS after the window everyone relied on.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_section_wise_rejects_unknown_question_key
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; config: section-wise scoring enabled on the RFP; the form is a vendor-assessment form; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 15 with message 'Invalid question keys: QA_Platform_bogus_key' from validate_and_parse_question_scores (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:838-841). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Keys must be the form's page_response_headers key_attributes; an unknown key would otherwise be stored and weighted as 0.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_section_wise_rejects_score_above_max
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; config: section-wise scoring; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator; the question key is valid.
steps: 1. POST /evaluations with a question score of 99999.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 15 'Score for q1 must be between 0 and <section_wise_max_score>' (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:848-850). No evaluations / evaluation_scores row is written.
rationale: Section-wise scores are floats with a per-form max, unlike the label-key scores.

title: QA_Platform_schema_rejects_nonexistent_trade
preconditions: Caller is the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 4 'Request not found' — validate_event returns 4 when trade is nil (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2215), called from app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:276-277.
rationale: The evaluator's first call; a nil trade must be a clean 4, not a nil dereference in the Dynamo logging that follows.

title: QA_Platform_schema_rejects_uninvited_vendor
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; caller is a vendor user who is NOT in the RFP's audience.
steps: 1. GET the RFP schema as that vendor.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 536 'You are not allowed to view this event.' — validate_event checks trade.is_allowed_to_view?(Current.user) (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:2219-2221).
rationale: The schema carries sheets.forms with evaluator assignments and extra_closing_time; an uninvited vendor must not read another vendor's technical round.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_via_post_is_not_routed
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event.
expectedResult: Routing error (404) — config/routes.rb:741-742 declares only `patch 'submit'`. The existing library cases EVAL-QCS-001..004 use POST and therefore never reach the controller.
rationale: Documents that the four existing submit cases are exercising the router, not the guards they describe.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_rejects_before_close_patch
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time is in the future; the evaluator has draft scores.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 — trade_request.bid_end_time > Time.now (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:42). No Proposal created by create_proposal_for_evaluations.
rationale: Same guard as EVAL-QCS-001 but on the route that actually exists (PATCH).

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_rejects_partial_scoring
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time passed; two vendors responded; the evaluator scored only one.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 571 'Please, evaluate on all fields' — rfp_evaluation_count_invalid? compares expected (participants × items) with draft/peer_review scores (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:811-832, returned at app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:609).
rationale: A half-scored submission would create a technical proposal that disqualifies the unscored vendor by omission.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_rejects_vendor_caller
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; caller is a vendor.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 33 — the trade lookup is scoped to Current.workspace.id (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:41).
rationale: Wrong actor on the call that publishes the technical outcome.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_unknown_action_type_only_saves
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time passed; the evaluator scored every vendor.
expectedResult: 200 with a DRAFT proposal and no approval started — only action_type == 'proposal_submit' submits (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:97-100). Never 5xx.
rationale: An unknown enum is silently treated as 'save', which a client may mistake for a submission.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_section_wise_without_form_rejected
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; config: section-wise scoring enabled; caller is NOT on an evaluating team; all sections scored.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — section-wise submission needs form_ids.first (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:85-87); get_form_ids_for_evaluation_submission returns [] without form_id (app/helpers/api/evaluations_helper.rb:749-762).
rationale: CONFIG-dependent: the same body is valid when section-wise scoring is off.

title: QA_Platform_evaluation_submit_double_patch_inside_lock
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; bid_end_time passed; every vendor scored.
expectedResult: Second call → HTTP 422 code 516 (app/controllers/api/evaluations_controller.rb:113-119). One draft technical proposal.
rationale: find_or_initialize_draft_proposal is not atomic; the 3s cache lock is the only guard against two proposals.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_line_items_rejected_outside_evaluation_time
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; the RFP is still live (before bid_end_time).
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 101 — render_error_json(101) unless trade_request.in_evaluation_time? (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1316); in_evaluation_time? is the window bid_end_time..extra_closing_time.
rationale: Re-evaluation is only meaningful during evaluation time; listing items outside it invites requests that will all fail.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_rejected_during_bidding
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; the RFP is still live.
steps: 1. PATCH request_tr_reevaluation with a form uuid and remarks.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 101 (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1352). No AdditionalRequest created.
rationale: 'Only during evaluation time' rule.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_rejected_after_extra_closing_time
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; now is after extra_closing_time.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 101 — in_evaluation_time? (alias of is_auction_in_extra_closing_time?, app/models/trade_request.rb:968) is false after the window (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1352).
rationale: Upper bound of the same rule; contrast with first-time scoring, which has no upper bound.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_without_form_uuids_must_not_500
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; line-item (not lot) evaluation.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2/786. Today form_ids is nil and `(form_ids & form_objects.pluck(:id))` raises NoMethodError (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1364) → 500.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the only params guard is id.blank? (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1349); form_ids is never presence-checked.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_form_uuids_as_string_must_not_500
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time.
steps: 1. PATCH request_tr_reevaluation with form_ids = "12" (a string, not an array).
expectedResult: Must be 422. String#& does not exist → NoMethodError at app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1364 → 500 today.
rationale: Wrong container type.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_rejects_form_not_visible_to_caller
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; the caller can see some forms.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 786 'Select correct line items for reevaluation' — (form_ids & allowed ids) != form_ids (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1364-1366).
rationale: Re-evaluation resets another evaluator's score; it must be limited to forms the requester can see.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_rejects_item_not_tr_submitted
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; the form's evaluation is still DRAFT (evaluator has not submitted TR); form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 786 — get_item_status returns reevaluation_disabled_reason 'TR is Pending' for evaluation_status draft (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5680-5691), refused at app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1379-1381.
rationale: 'Only TR-submitted items' rule: you cannot send back something that was never handed in.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_rejects_item_already_requested
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; a re-evaluation for this form is already pending; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
steps: 1. PATCH request_tr_reevaluation for the same form again.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 786 ('Reevaluation is already requested', app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:5688-5689) or, if the status check is bypassed, 787 'Reevaluation already Requested' (app/helpers/api/additional_requests_helper.rb:555).
rationale: Two pending requests on one score would each flip it back to draft on accept.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_request_without_reason_is_not_enforced
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; TR submitted for the form; form.uuid is {{evalFormUuid}}, the form assigned to the evaluator.
expectedResult: Per product rules the reason is mandatory; the backend stores request_remark: remarks || '' (app/helpers/api/additional_requests_helper.rb:574) and accepts it. Record: 200 means the rule lives only in the UI. Never 5xx.
rationale: 'Reason required' is enforced client-side only — an API caller can send an evaluator's score back with no justification.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_resolve_rejects_unknown_action
preconditions: {{rfpTradeId}} is the TECHNICAL (RFP) stage of the sandbox event; inside evaluation time; a pending re-evaluation exists; caller is the requested evaluator.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 code 2 — return 2 if !action.in?(['accept','reject']) (app/helpers/additional_request_resolution_helper.rb:1146).
rationale: Invalid enum on the call that either resets or keeps a score.

title: QA_Platform_reeval_resolve_rejects_non_requested_evaluator

title: QA_Platform_add_response_over_line_quantity_with_partial_awarding

title: QA_Platform_add_response_exact_line_quantity_with_partial_awarding
preconditions: Config: is_partial_awarding_enabled on; line quantity 10; nothing else awarded.
expectedResult: 200 — 0 + 10 is not > 10 (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:837).

title: QA_Platform_add_response_over_quantity_is_unchecked_when_both_configs_off
preconditions: Config: is_partial_awarding_enabled OFF and is_over_awarding_allowed OFF (the defaults); line quantity 10.
expectedResult: Expected 422 code 561. Today when awarded_quantity is supplied and neither config is on, none of the if/elsif branches applies and validate_awarding_quantity returns nil (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:820-839) — the value is stored unchecked.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: the quantity ceiling exists only when one of two opt-in configs is on; the journey's own awarded_quantity lands on this branch by default.

title: QA_Platform_add_response_negative_quantity_with_partial_awarding
preconditions: Config: is_partial_awarding_enabled on.
expectedResult: Expected 422. The only comparison is sum + awarded > egli_quantity (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:837); -5 passes. get_previously_fulfilled_quantity later clamps negatives to 0 for OTHER vendors (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:1327-1328), which lets the next vendor be awarded the full quantity on top.
rationale: DEFECT-IN-WAITING: no lower bound (the existing AWD-PART-001/002 expect a refusal the code does not make).

title: QA_Platform_add_response_zero_quantity_with_partial_awarding
preconditions: Config: is_partial_awarding_enabled on.
expectedResult: Expected 422. 0 passes the ceiling check (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:837) and — note — awarded_quantity_provided uses .present?, which is TRUE for 0 (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:820). A vendor 'awarded' 0 still becomes a PO recipient.
rationale: Zero awards create empty POs.

title: QA_Platform_add_response_non_numeric_quantity
preconditions: Config: is_partial_awarding_enabled on.
expectedResult: Expected 422. safe_to_f('ten') is 0.0 (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:1346-1354), so it is validated as 0 but the RAW string is merged into responses_hash (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:1099-1100).

title: QA_Platform_add_response_over_awarding_allowed_without_pr_is_unbounded
preconditions: Config: is_over_awarding_allowed ON; the line is NOT linked to a PR.
expectedResult: 200 by design — `elsif is_over_awarding_allowed && !pr_mapping_exists` returns nil (app/helpers/api/proposal_helper.rb:834-835); over_quantity_tolerance_percentage is ignored without a PR.
rationale: CONFIG: the tolerance only bounds PR-linked lines; a manual event with over-awarding on has no ceiling at all.

title: QA_Platform_add_response_over_awarding_above_pr_tolerance_rejected
preconditions: Config: is_over_awarding_allowed ON, over_quantity_tolerance_percentage 10; the line is PR-linked with 10 open.

title: QA_Platform_add_response_over_awarding_partial_off_requires_full
preconditions: Config: is_over_awarding_allowed ON, is_partial_awarding_enabled OFF; PR-linked line of 10.

title: QA_Platform_add_response_rejects_line_item_marked_regret

title: QA_Platform_add_response_allows_tna_vendor_when_stage_allows_tna_bidding

title: QA_Platform_approval_workflows_evaluating_team_gets_empty_body

title: QA_Platform_submit_after_removing_every_vendor_is_empty

title: QA_Platform_submit_without_step_map_must_not_500

title: QA_Platform_submit_without_flow_when_approvals_exist_rejected

title: QA_Platform_submit_undecodable_flow_behaves_as_no_flow
preconditions: destructive — acts on the sandbox copy only and must run last: if the company has NO award approval configured, this body awards the proposal for real via close_bids. {{proposalUuid}} is a populated draft on the sandbox copy; the company HAS an award approval.

title: QA_Platform_submit_ghost_flow_rejected
